cells.gaps: No admitted fact says how the record is made on the digital birth registration platform or on Kadodo: the only `made` row, TGO-015, is 2018 data and speaks of paper exchange between offices, not of the entry. The 16 Savanes communes (TGO-010) are centres digitised and trained to use the platform, not said to register on it, and no total is given beside them (TGO-001 mentions 117 communes). Events disagree: the 2024 platform names births only (TGO-008), Kadodo in Lacs 1 named births and deaths in 2021 (TGO-012). The owner is now held from the July 2026 tender (TGO-016), which names the digital ministry as employer of a sixteen-commune pilot financed by a German development bank; the 2024 roadmap (TGO-006) gives no period.
cells.note: The platform is in its pilot phase at one town hall, Golfe 3 (TGO-008, TGO-009), and the Savanes centres are equipped and trained, not shown registering. Stage 3 needs births past the pilot and live in some local offices with the record made digitally, and no fact says either.
